author: Slidebean
description:
Why self directed AI learning changes the definition of intelligence.

The emergence of self directed learning systems marks a major inflection point in AI development.
By generating their own questions and refining knowledge autonomously, these models reduce reliance on human input while accelerating progress.

The long term implication isn’t just better performance,  it’s a shift toward continuously evolving systems that redefine intelligence on their own terms.

title: AI isn’t just learning anymore, it’s teaching itself
